description: Find Natural Resources Wales telemetry stations by station name (anonymous, OGL v3). Returns station references for nrw_measures; data is provisional. Returns source data and provenance; supported hydrological units are normalised to SI. TerraMCP is a Wrench AI service. Open data: no API key or signup required. Anonymous limits: 60 calls/hour and 300/day per IP and session; keys offer higher limits, with anonymous fallback after monthly quota. Source licence warnings apply.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return; bounded by this tool's schema.

name.description: Station name to search for within this provider.
